Class SnackMachine

java.lang.Object
SnackMachine
public class SnackMachine extends Object
This class represents a real world snack machine, that allows for the payment of crisps from the PackOfCrisps class. It allows the insertion of many Penny and PackOfCrisps objects (if the maximum amount of crisps allowed in the machine is not exceeded), and provides a pack of crisps if the right number of Penny onjects are inserted. This class counts the price of the crisps, the amount of crisps of a specified flavour within the machine, the amount of Penny objects already inserted (if no packs have been bought yet) and the amount of packs bought from the machine.

      public int countPacks(String flavour)
      Counts the number of packs in the machine of a given string flavour. This method goes through every pack in the machine and increments the numOfFlavours by 1 whenever the specified string flavour is equal to the pack string flavour.
      Parameters:
      flavour - the flavour that is going to be counted.
      Returns:
      the amount of packs of a specified flavour.
